replies.text: In most American cities, leaving bundled-up infants unattended to nap in the snow would immediately raise alarm bells, yet in Sweden, it is seen as perfectly normal and healthy for kids.

comments.text: Sweden always looks perfect in documentaries, but I wonder how much tourists really get to see beyond the beautiful scenery and free healthcare. 🇸🇪 Is Sweden genuinely as good as it looks, or are there everyday problems that visitors rarely notice?
